name: Siwakorn Suriya

personal data: Mobile Developer with hands-on experience managing app stores (Google Play Store & Apple App Store), maintaining and updating legacy apps for modern OS versions, and engineering new business-oriented applications. Specializing primarily in Kotlin Native for Android, with foundational experience in Swift and collaborative development using Flutter.
aboutme: Hello, I’m Siwakorn Suriya (Jay). I graduated with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering from King Mongkut's Institute of Technology Ladkrabang. Currently working as a Mobile Developer with core expertise in native Android development using Kotlin. I have solid experience managing app deployments and store compliance, refactoring and upgrading legacy applications, and delivering end-to-end business solutions from ground up. I have also worked briefly with Swift on iOS and touched Flutter for cross-platform requirements. Driven by continuous learning and delivering scalable, user-centric mobile products.
